policy: Reviewed serializations are separated from unresolved debt. Exact full-source and caller locks fail closed on any edit. Raw AST shape counts remain visible; no new unresolved debt is permitted.

entries.why: READ COMMITTED saveDraft takes a question-key advisory lock before checking draft/attribution, plus a round ordinal lock before MAX+1. seal takes the exclusive round lock before reading answers; clarify/seal.ts opens the caller transaction. Regressions: rfc395-clarify-target-concurrency.test.ts.

replaceOutputs uses withTaskExecutionWrite (READ COMMITTED), then fencedTaskId: owner fence -> task root -> node-run lock, before reading/deleting/inserting outputs for that nodeRunId. Regressions: rfc395-run-write-atomicity.test.ts.
